column1: # Previous mean of top-level PASS records from three successful post-#998
# main-push Go CI runs, successively refreshed with passing native-shard samples
# from PR runs 43629705788 attempt 1 and 43634202737 attempt 1 (Linux X64,
# retries 0, test-result cache disabled, warm Go dependency cache; all four
# native jobs passed in each run, but the first run was cancelled after native
# execution and the second failed in remaining-package tests). These refreshes
# are for placement only, not issue acceptance evidence:
# Each refresh blended 75% of the prior estimate with 25% of the newest passing
# native-shard sample. Rows without a passing sample retain their prior value.
# Unchanged rows use mean top-level PASS seconds; regrouped rows use disjoint
# child PASS seconds where cases moved between top-level tests. Never add child
# durations to their parent when calculating a cost.
